# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The 4.0 pre-release series is not recommended for production and as such
does not get the same level of support as the 3.x series. Bug reports are
encouraged, though.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 4.0.x   | :x:                |
| 3.11.x  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 3.11  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

See the [security](https://github.com/agronholm/apscheduler/security)
section to view existing security advisories or to report a new vulnerability.
